conditioningLevel.rationale: High: C2 met - early (prominent) silicone Dimethiconol@10, a cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@15, a pearlizing route Glycol Distearate@7 and a deliberate humectant entry Panthenol@24; cleansing strength does not lower conditioning (C2). Supporting Dimethicone@13. Counter-signals: guar and the humectant are post-E3 (guar after preservative, panthenol trace), so moderate is the realistic neighbor.
